# KVS 7.0.3 compatibility and safer stack operations

## Upgrade instructions

Update the CLI, check the proposed release, then upgrade the stack:

```sh
kvsctl update-cli
kvsctl check
kvsctl upgrade
```

This release requires `kvsctl 26.10.4` so backups and upgrades use the new
history-preservation and cancellation safeguards. It introduces no database
migration. Updating the CLI alone does not replace the running containers;
the stack upgrade installs the release's pinned images and files.

## PHP selection for KVS 7.0.3

The Docker and standalone installers now default to PHP 8.3 for KVS 7.0.3
and newer. Previously, they selected PHP 8.1, which could leave an encoded
KVS 7.0.3 installation with a blank page. Earlier KVS versions retain their
existing defaults, and an explicit PHP selection is still honored.
([#33](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/issues/33),
[e34f4cc](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/e34f4cc))

An existing stack keeps its selected PHP and MariaDB series during an
upgrade. If KVS 7.0.3 is already installed with files that require newer PHP,
set `PHP_VERSION=8.3` in that installation's `docker/.env` before running
`kvsctl check` and `kvsctl upgrade`. Check the KVS files' ionCube requirements
before changing PHP on an older installation.

## Setup and imports

- Preserve quoted and multiline settings when saving installer choices,
  including Compose projects and profiles, domains, PHP image pins,
  MariaDB, Manticore, ionCube and TLS settings.
- Read effective saved settings consistently on repeated setup and import
  runs. Verify import completion receipts before cleaning up source files,
  and stop before a transfer when its settings cannot be saved.
- Validate the requested installation mode and TLS provider before retiring
  an existing project or certificate service. Retry failed certificate-store
  updates and clean up failed ionCube extraction attempts.
- Correct transfer progress for rsync byte suffixes and large initial rates,
  preserve transfer exit status, and check IPv6 wildcard ports over IPv6.
- Point imported cache configurations at the managed cache endpoint,
  including imports that used a nonstandard port.
  ([23d890e](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/23d890e))

## Backups, exports and CLI operations

- Preserve timestamp-based MariaDB system-versioned table history. Backups
  containing these tables use archive format 3 and require this CLI to
  restore; ordinary backups remain format 2. Refuse incompatible history
  restores before stopping the site or changing its database. Tables using
  transaction-precise history cannot be exported and cause the backup to
  stop rather than silently lose history.
  ([f967617](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/f967617))
- Stop canceled command descendants and interrupted database dumps before
  releasing locks. Distinguish a canceled CLI update from a version timeout.
- Preserve previous export files until a new export completes. Handle
  mounted destinations and complete filenames correctly. Reject linked
  dumps and manifests during import, skip special files during backup
  discovery, and stop if dump decompression fails.
- Record the effective domain in backup metadata. Keep release records when
  image removal fails and report download-cache inspection errors.

## Nginx and release images

- Deny hidden assets before static-file handlers and limit the `.well-known`
  exception to that exact directory.
  ([fe6bff9](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/fe6bff9),
  [bce2633](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/bce2633))
- Resume interrupted log rotations without losing existing generations.
  ([6b77d21](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/6b77d21))
- Refresh upstream image digests and rebuild the release images. The PHP
  security fixes shipped in 26.10.3 remain included, including the PHP 8.1
  source backport. PHP 8.1 remains end of life.

[Full comparison with 26.10.3](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/compare/26.10.3...26.10.4)
